{{Quote|The Empire is always expanding its operations in Mos Eisley. For the benefit of the Emperor and his Sith, not the people of Mos Eisley methinks.|[[Watto/Legends|Watto]]|<ref name="spy" />}}
The '''Imperial garrison base''' was a [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] outpost built by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was purposely located on Tatooine as the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] had just won major victories such as the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] which saw the destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|First Death Star]]. Even though the [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] himself had come to oversee the expansion of the base, not too long after the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] departure, [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Anduvil]] managed to infiltrate the stronghold and sabotage the complex, destroying it completely.

==Layout==
[[File:Imperial_garrison_base.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Overview of the base]]
The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] garrison base was a fortified and immense stronghold in the [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooinian]] [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]], with several buildings inside, as well as a [[Bridge (starship)|command bridge]] between two [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] towers.<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> Its facilities included a [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], a [[Medcenter/Legends|medical center]], a [[Detention area|detention block]]<ref name="sojourn" /> a [[landing platform]], a main patio and outward-facing [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]].<ref name="spy" /> The main gate was located in [[Straight Street/Legends|Straight Street]], while the rest of the outpost overlooked [[Kerner Plaza/Legends|Kerner Plaza]].<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

The base housed a large contingent of [[Soldier/Legends|troops]], [[Imperial officer/Legends|officers]] and a [[Doctor/Legends|medical staff]], and at various [[Time/Legends|times]] has harbored vehicles such as a [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]], [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transports]],<ref name="spy" /> [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|All Terrain Scout Transports]], [[All Terrain Advance Raider]]s, [[Armored tank/Legends|armored tanks]], [[Omega-class freighter|''Omega''-class freighters]], a [[TIE lander/Legends|TIE lander]]<ref name="ItWoSWT" /> and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]].<ref name="sojourn" />

==History==
{{Quote|The Imperial garrison base, an area I only visit when I have to. But sometimes it's-a not so easy to say no to the Empire, eh? Vader himself has come to oversee the expansion of the base and his presence has angered a few of the locals. But it's-a not too bad, eh? There are droid bargains to be had and it's nice to observe the wildlife and take in the ancient city. While it still stands, eh?|Watto|<ref name="spy" />}}
[[File:VaderAtImperialGarrisonBase-GalacticSpy.png|thumb|Darth Vader arrives at the Base.]]
In large part due to the events of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] destruction of the [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]], an Imperial-built [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]/[[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] capable of annihilating entire worlds,<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref> the Galactic Empire chose to symbolically build a permanent military outpost on Tatooine.<ref name="sojourn" /> In [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], accompanied by a member of the [[Emperor's Royal Guard/Legends|Emperor's Royal Guard]], personally visited the base to oversee its expansion, causing a commotion among the locals.<ref name="spy" /> For this enlargement project, the Empire routinely employed armored tanks to demolish neighboring private residential homes in order to expand the garrison's limits towards Kerner Plaza.<ref name="ItWoSWT" />

The [[Toydarian/Legends|Toydarian]] junkyard entrepreneur [[Watto/Legends|Watto]] occasionally had to visit the base, mostly because he had a hard time otherwise refusing the Empire's requests. Nonetheless, he saw the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] bargains, observing the wildlife and admiring the ancient city of Mos Eisley as compensation for the trouble of dealing with the Empire. Watto also suspected that the establishment of the base was largely intended to benefit [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] allies rather than the people of Mos Eisley.<ref name="spy" />

[[File:Base_blowing_up.png|thumb|left|200px|The base is blown up as Luke and Anduvil escape.]]
By this time, the base's medical facility was used to, among other things, analyze potential cases of [[Bledsoe's disease]] infections. The medical staff, under the auspices of [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Kaaldar]], would record the [[Star map/Legends|star maps]] gleaned from its "window-eyes" symptom, as it revealed the location of secret bases operated by the Rebel Alliance.

This practice was, however, unexpectedly sidetracked after a [[transport capsule]] containing Bledsoe's disease ended up unwittingly intercepted by a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]]. Rebel Alliance member [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], having been infected with Bledsoe's while [[Mission to Tatooine (Luke Skywalker)|investigating]] the remains of the sandcrawler, was later delivered to the base, where the Imperials admitted Skywalker to a medical chamber. A portion of the base's main gate was later severely damaged after the sandcrawler, manned by Skywalker's droids, [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], attempted to breach the base in an attempt to rescue Skywalker.<ref name="sojourn" />

The Imperial garrison base was later utterly destroyed when [[Alliance Intelligence/Legends|Rebel intelligence]] operative [[Anduvil]] sabotaged one of the TIE/LN starfighter's [[P-s4 twin ion engine]]s by realigning the [[Energizer/Legends|energizer]] and thus compromising the recharging system. Anduvil had done this by infiltrating the main hangar bay, which at the time was left unguarded due to the unintentional diversion caused by C-3PO and R2-D2's attempt to breach the main gates. The ensuing ion explosion engulfed the complex and killed a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and officers, as well as Doctor Kaaldar, while Luke, Anduvil and the droids safely escaped on a [[Landspeeder/Legends|landspeeder]].<ref name="sojourn" />

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:Main_gate.png|thumb|250px|''Tatooine Sojourn''{{'s}} view from the main gate showed a vast desert on the horizon, in opposition to ''Inside the Worlds'', which depicted it inside the city of Mos Eisley.]]
The Imperial garrison base was first introduced in [[1979]]'s comic strip ''[[Tatooine Sojourn]]'', distributed by the [[Los Angeles Times Syndicate]], written by [[Steve Gerber]] and drawn by [[Russ Manning]]. The outpost was formally named in [[2004]]'s reference book ''[[Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy]]'' and reused in 2012's online puzzle game ''[[Star Wars Galactic Spy]]''.

The depiction of the base, however, is somewhat different between ''Tatooine Sojourn'' and ''Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy'', while ''Star Wars Galactic Spy'' mainly draws from ''Inside the Worlds'', with small adaptations, such as the addition of military units and characters. ''Tatooine Sojourn'' places the outpost amidst a Tatooinian desert, on the outskirts of Mos Eisley while ''Inside the Worlds of Star Wars Trilogy'' places it within the city. Other differences such as in the design, size and coloring employed between both versions are also visible.

Due to the fact that the three stories are set around [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and in the same region, this article assumes they refer to the same structure.
